# Pixel Memory Match

A pixel memory-match game with 8 pairs of colored cards. Flip two at a time, matched pairs stay open, count moves, show a win message and a New game button.

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or network required.

## Features

- 8 pairs of colored cards (16 cards total)
- Shuffled deck on load and on New Game
- Move counter increments per pair flip
- Matched pairs stay open
- Win message when all pairs matched
- New Game button resets deck, moves, and win message
- Keyboard-accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive layout from 360px wide

## Files

- `index.html` — structure
- `styles.css` — styling and responsive layout
- `game.js` — game logic

## Palette

- Background: `#1e1e2f`
- Card back: `#3a3a55`
- Accent: `#f0c040`
- Matched: `#2e7d32`
- Text: `#e0e0e0`
